toneBlindspotLabels.ROAST_SAFE: The part you may not want to hear

bands.pattern: Your career signals show exceptional alignment this month, with palm features and astrological indicators reinforcing each other.
bands.trigger: Momentum like this tends to attract new commitments and bigger asks.
bands.cost: Saying yes to everything can quietly convert strength into overload.

bands.pattern: Your career energy is in a positive phase, with a solid foundation and steady indicators of growth.
bands.trigger: Visible progress invites more responsibility and higher expectations.
bands.cost: Untended, expectations can outpace the systems that support you.

bands.pattern: Your career is in a transitional period — fundamentals are stable while some areas ask for focused attention.
bands.trigger: Ambiguity about priorities is the usual spark for drift.
bands.cost: Spreading effort thin delays the breakthrough you are close to.

bands.pattern: Your career readings suggest a building phase — a time for patience and intentional groundwork rather than bold moves.
bands.trigger: Pressure to show quick results can tempt reactive choices.
bands.cost: Skipping the groundwork now tends to cost double later.

bands.pattern: Your career indicators are asking for attention this month — not an alarm, but an invitation to pause and recalibrate.
bands.trigger: Fatigue and frustration are often the triggers for rushed decisions.
bands.cost: Deciding while depleted narrows options that rest would restore.

career.blindspotHigh: When career energy is strong, there is a tendency to overcommit — success can mask the early signs of burnout.
career.blindspotLow: During challenging career periods, avoid reactive decisions; give yourself at least 48 hours before responding to stressful situations.
career.actionTodayHigh: Identify one person whose work you admire and send them a specific compliment.
career.actionTodayLow: Spend 10 minutes listing what is going well in your career — not what needs fixing.
career.actionWeekHigh: Take on one stretch assignment just outside your comfort zone.
career.actionWeekLow: Block two 30-minute thinking slots this week — no meetings, no tasks.
career.promptHigh: Would you choose this work if money were not a factor? What would you redesign about your role?
career.promptLow: If your current career challenges were trying to teach you something, what would the lesson be?

bands.pattern: Your wealth signals are notably steady this month, reflecting habits that compound quietly in your favor.
bands.trigger: Feeling flush is the classic trigger for lifestyle creep.
bands.cost: Small unexamined upgrades can absorb the surplus you worked for.

bands.pattern: Your financial awareness is in a healthy phase, with steady signals around planning and follow-through.
bands.trigger: Confidence invites bigger commitments before systems are ready.
bands.cost: Commitments made casually can crowd out flexibility later.

bands.pattern: Your wealth picture is in transition — the basics hold while a few habits ask for a closer look.
bands.trigger: Routine spending on autopilot is where drift usually starts.
bands.cost: Unexamined defaults quietly set your ceiling.

bands.pattern: Your wealth readings point to a consolidation phase — clarity first, expansion later.
bands.trigger: Comparison with others is a common trigger for stretch purchases.
bands.cost: Buying relief instead of addressing the cause compounds the strain.

bands.pattern: Your wealth indicators ask for gentle attention this month — awareness, not anxiety, is the goal.
bands.trigger: Money stress tends to trigger either freezing or splurging.
bands.cost: Both extremes postpone the small repairs that actually help.

wealth.blindspotHigh: Financial confidence can lead to lifestyle inflation — the gap between can afford and should buy widens when things feel abundant.
wealth.blindspotLow: When wealth signals are lower, watch for both panic-saving and stress-spending.
wealth.actionTodayHigh: Review your subscriptions and cancel one you haven't used this month.
wealth.actionTodayLow: Identify one free activity that genuinely makes you happy.
wealth.actionWeekHigh: Set up one automatic transfer into savings this week.
wealth.actionWeekLow: Have one honest conversation about money this week.
wealth.promptHigh: Beyond financial security, what does enough look like for you?
wealth.promptLow: If you could change one money habit tomorrow, which would have the biggest ripple effect?
safetyNotes: For personal reflection only — this is not financial or tax guidance of any kind.

bands.pattern: Your family signals show warm, steady alignment this month, with connection coming more easily than usual.
bands.trigger: Harmony can invite complacency about checking in.
bands.cost: Assuming everyone is fine can leave quiet needs unheard.

bands.pattern: Your family energy is in a positive phase, with communication flowing and small repairs happening naturally.
bands.trigger: Busy seasons are the usual trigger for postponed time together.
bands.cost: Postponed presence reads as absence to the people closest to you.

bands.pattern: Your family picture is in transition — the bond is stable while some conversations wait their turn.
bands.trigger: Small misunderstandings left unaddressed tend to accumulate.
bands.cost: What goes unsaid this month gets harder to say next month.

bands.pattern: Your family readings suggest a mending phase — small consistent gestures matter more than grand ones.
bands.trigger: Old patterns resurface fastest under stress.
bands.cost: Reacting from habit can reopen what patience was healing.

bands.pattern: Your family indicators ask for softness this month — presence over performance.
bands.trigger: Distance often triggers stories about rejection that are not true.
bands.cost: Acting on those stories widens the very gap you fear.

family.blindspotHigh: Strong family harmony can make you assume everyone is fine — the quietest family member may need the most attention.
family.blindspotLow: During challenging family periods, remember that distance is not always rejection — sometimes people need space.
family.actionTodayHigh: Put your phone down during dinner and be fully present.
family.actionTodayLow: Write down one thing you appreciate about a family member but have not told them.
family.actionWeekHigh: Plan a specific activity with family — not just hanging out, but doing one named thing together.
family.actionWeekLow: Spend 20 minutes this week on one family relationship that needs attention.
family.promptHigh: What is one conversation you've been avoiding, and what would it take to have it with compassion?
family.promptLow: What is one expectation you hold for a family relationship that might be worth examining?

bands.pattern: Your wellbeing signals look strong this month, with energy and recovery working in your favor.
bands.trigger: Feeling invincible is the usual trigger for skipped rest.
bands.cost: Rest skipped now tends to collect interest later.

bands.pattern: Your wellbeing energy is in a positive phase, with steady rhythms supporting you.
bands.trigger: Good streaks invite quietly raising the load.
bands.cost: Raising the load without raising recovery erodes the streak.

bands.pattern: Your wellbeing picture is in transition — the basics hold while sleep or stress ask for attention.
bands.trigger: Deadlines are the classic trigger for borrowed sleep.
bands.cost: Borrowed sleep is repaid with slower, foggier days.

bands.pattern: Your wellbeing readings suggest a rebuilding phase — small habits before ambitious plans.
bands.trigger: All-or-nothing thinking is the usual trigger for abandoning routines.
bands.cost: Restart costs grow every time the routine is dropped entirely.

bands.pattern: Your wellbeing indicators are inviting you to slow down and care for the basics — this is an invitation, not a verdict.
bands.trigger: Running on empty triggers the habits that empty you further.
bands.cost: Ignoring the basics makes everything else feel heavier than it is.

health.blindspotHigh: Good wellbeing readings can create a false sense of invincibility — this is the best time to build preventive habits.
health.blindspotLow: Lower wellbeing indicators are not predictions — they are invitations to prioritize yourself. Start with basics: sleep, water, movement.
health.actionTodayHigh: Do something physical you enjoy — walking, dancing, stretching.
health.actionTodayLow: Go to bed 30 minutes earlier tonight.
health.actionWeekHigh: Try one new healthy recipe this week.
health.actionWeekLow: Choose one evening this week to fully unplug an hour before bed.
health.promptHigh: Your body is your longest relationship — how is the communication quality right now?
health.promptLow: If your body could write you a letter this week, what would it say?
safetyNotes: For self-awareness only — this is not a health assessment and offers no guidance about any condition.

bands.pattern: 本月你的事業訊號高度對齊，掌紋與星象指標彼此呼應。
bands.trigger: 這樣的動能往往吸引新的承諾與更大的期待。
bands.cost: 對每件事都說好，可能悄悄把優勢變成過載。

bands.pattern: 你的事業能量處於積極階段，基礎穩固並有持續成長的跡象。
bands.trigger: 看得見的進展會帶來更多責任與更高期待。
bands.cost: 若不留意，期待可能超過支撐你的節奏與系統。

bands.pattern: 你的事業正處於轉型期——基本面穩定，部分領域需要專注的投入。
bands.trigger: 優先順序不明，是漂移最常見的起點。
bands.cost: 力量分散會延後你其實已經接近的突破。

bands.pattern: 你的事業讀數顯示累積階段——適合耐心打底，而非大動作。
bands.trigger: 急於展現成果的壓力，容易引發倉促的選擇。
bands.cost: 現在略過基本功，之後往往要加倍償還。

bands.pattern: 本月你的事業指標提醒你多加留意——這不是警報，而是重新校準的邀請。
bands.trigger: 疲憊與挫折常是倉促決定的引信。
bands.cost: 在耗竭時做決定，會關上休息本可打開的選項。

career.blindspotHigh: 事業能量強勁時，容易過度承諾——成功可能掩蓋倦怠的早期跡象。
career.blindspotLow: 在事業低潮期，避免做出反應式的決定；面對壓力情境，先給自己至少48小時。
career.actionTodayHigh: 找一位你欣賞的人，針對他最近做的具體事情給予讚美。
career.actionTodayLow: 花10分鐘列出你事業中順利的事——而非需要修正的。
career.actionWeekHigh: 接下一個略超出舒適區的任務或專案。
career.actionWeekLow: 本週安排兩個30分鐘的「思考時間」——不開會、不做任務。
career.promptHigh: 如果錢不是問題，你會選擇做同樣的工作嗎？你會重新設計角色的哪個部分？
career.promptLow: 如果現在的職涯挑戰想教你一件事，那會是什麼？

bands.pattern: 本月你的財富訊號格外穩定，反映出正在默默累積的習慣。
bands.trigger: 手頭寬裕，是生活方式膨脹最典型的引信。
bands.cost: 未經檢視的小升級，會吸走你努力得來的餘裕。

bands.pattern: 你的財務覺察處於健康階段，規劃與執行的訊號穩定。
bands.trigger: 自信會讓你在系統就緒前就做出更大的承諾。
bands.cost: 隨口答應的承諾，之後會擠壓你的彈性。

bands.pattern: 你的財富狀態正在過渡——基礎仍在，部分習慣值得重新檢視。
bands.trigger: 自動導航式的例行花費，是漂移的常見起點。
bands.cost: 未經檢視的預設值，會默默決定你的上限。

bands.pattern: 你的財富讀數指向整理期——先求清楚，再談擴張。
bands.trigger: 與他人比較，常引發勉強的消費。
bands.cost: 用購買換取安慰而不處理原因，只會累積壓力。

bands.pattern: 本月你的財富指標需要溫和的關注——目標是覺察，不是焦慮。
bands.trigger: 金錢壓力常導致凍結或衝動消費兩種極端。
bands.cost: 兩種極端都會延後真正有幫助的小修補。

wealth.blindspotHigh: 財務自信可能導致生活方式膨脹——「能負擔」和「該不該買」的差距會在順境中擴大。
wealth.blindspotLow: 當財富訊號較低時，留意恐慌性儲蓄與壓力性消費這兩種極端。
wealth.actionTodayHigh: 檢視你的訂閱服務，取消一個這個月沒使用的。
wealth.actionTodayLow: 找出一個真正讓你開心的免費活動。
wealth.actionWeekHigh: 本週設定一筆自動轉入儲蓄的固定金額。
wealth.actionWeekLow: 本週和一個人坦誠地聊聊金錢。
wealth.promptHigh: 在財務安全之外，「足夠」對你來說是什麼樣子？
wealth.promptLow: 如果明天能改變一個金錢習慣，哪一個會產生最大的漣漪效應？
safetyNotes: 本內容僅供個人成長參考，不構成任何財務或稅務方面的引導。

bands.pattern: 本月你的家庭訊號溫暖而穩定，連結比平常更自然。
bands.trigger: 和諧容易讓人疏於主動關心。
bands.cost: 假設大家都很好，可能讓安靜的需求無人聽見。

bands.pattern: 你的家庭能量處於積極階段，溝通順暢，小小的修復自然發生。
bands.trigger: 忙碌的季節最容易讓相處時間被延期。
bands.cost: 被延期的陪伴，在親近的人眼中就是缺席。

bands.pattern: 你的家庭狀態正在過渡——連結穩定，但有些對話在等待時機。
bands.trigger: 未被處理的小誤會傾向累積。
bands.cost: 這個月沒說出口的話，下個月更難開口。

bands.pattern: 你的家庭讀數顯示修補期——持續的小舉動勝過盛大的姿態。
bands.trigger: 壓力之下，舊模式浮現得最快。
bands.cost: 照習慣反應，可能重新撕開耐心正在癒合的地方。

bands.pattern: 本月你的家庭指標需要柔軟以對——重點是陪伴，不是表現。
bands.trigger: 距離常引發「被拒絕」的想像，但那未必是真的。
bands.cost: 照著想像行動，只會加深你害怕的距離。

family.blindspotHigh: 家庭和諧時容易假設每個人都很好——最安靜的家人可能最需要關注。
family.blindspotLow: 家庭關係困難時，記住距離並不總是拒絕——有時人們需要空間。
family.actionTodayHigh: 今晚吃飯時放下手機，全心與家人在一起。
family.actionTodayLow: 寫下一件你感謝某位家人、但從未說出口的事。
family.actionWeekHigh: 和家人安排一個具體活動——不是「找時間聚聚」，而是「週六一起做某件事」。
family.actionWeekLow: 本週花20分鐘，經營一段需要關注的家庭關係。
family.promptHigh: 有什麼對話你一直在迴避？帶著同理心開啟它，需要什麼？
family.promptLow: 你對某段家庭關係抱持的哪個期待，值得重新審視？

bands.pattern: 本月你的身心訊號強勁，活力與恢復都站在你這邊。
bands.trigger: 覺得所向無敵，是略過休息最常見的引信。
bands.cost: 現在省下的休息，之後會連本帶利討回。

bands.pattern: 你的身心能量處於積極階段，穩定的節奏正在支撐你。
bands.trigger: 狀態好的連勝，會讓人不知不覺加重負荷。
bands.cost: 只加負荷不加恢復，連勝就會中斷。

bands.pattern: 你的身心狀態正在過渡——基礎仍在，睡眠與壓力需要關注。
bands.trigger: 截止期限是向睡眠借時間的典型引信。
bands.cost: 借來的睡眠，會用遲鈍與昏沉的日子償還。

bands.pattern: 你的身心讀數顯示重建期——先養小習慣，再談大計畫。
bands.trigger: 全有全無的想法，最容易讓人放棄整個節奏。
bands.cost: 每次徹底中斷，重啟的成本就更高。

bands.pattern: 本月你的身心指標邀請你放慢腳步、照顧基本需求——這是邀請，不是評判。
bands.trigger: 身心透支時，最容易啟動讓你更透支的習慣。
bands.cost: 忽略基本需求，會讓其他事都顯得比實際更沉重。

health.blindspotHigh: 良好的身心讀數可能帶來虛假的安全感——這其實是建立預防習慣的最佳時機。
health.blindspotLow: 較低的身心指標不是預測——而是優先照顧自己的邀請。從基本做起：睡眠、補水、活動。
health.actionTodayHigh: 做一件你真正喜歡的身體活動——散步、跳舞、伸展。
health.actionWeekHigh: 本週試做一道新的健康料理。
health.actionWeekLow: 本週選一個晚上，睡前一小時完全遠離螢幕。
health.promptHigh: 身體是你最長久的關係——你們現在的溝通品質如何？
health.promptLow: 如果你的身體本週能寫一封信給你，它會說什麼？
safetyNotes: 本內容僅供自我覺察參考，不包含任何身體狀況的評估或引導。
